format: RFC 4180-compatible CSV with a header row and UTF-8 encoding

image_path.description: Absolute path or portable repository-relative path. Relative paths resolve from config.image_root; when omitted, training and audit use the repository root.

crop.description: Observed crop, not the model pack. Other observed crops are dynamically mapped to wrong_crop_leaf for each crop-specific pack.

condition_label.description: Stable taxonomy key, <crop>_other_unknown for open-set target leaves, or not_applicable when no crop condition applies.

group_id.description: Source/farm/plant/capture family identifier locked to exactly one split. It may be the transitive union of explicit lineage, exact hashes, near-duplicate pHashes, and source-configured filename capture evidence.

sha256.description: Exact byte-duplicate family; one value must never cross splits.

split_purposes.validation: early stopping and architecture selection only
split_purposes.test: one final in-domain report after model and thresholds freeze
split_purposes.external_test: source-held-out or Nepal field evaluation; never used for selection

filename_numeric_capture_group.purpose: Group ambiguous duplicate numeric stems and visually corroborated adjacent captures before split assignment.
required_fields: regex with a named number group
key_isolation: exact filename suffix for adjacent-stem grouping

invariants: Every source_id plus group_id pair belongs to exactly one split.
Every non-empty sha256 and duplicate_group belongs to exactly one split.

Every group may carry at most one canonical condition_label, including crop-specific unknown labels and not_applicable. No waiver is accepted by the default auditor; any future exception requires documented, group-specific adjudication and must remain excluded from evaluation.
Condition cross-entropy is applied only to usable_target_leaf rows whose condition_label is in the selected crop's known taxonomy.
A usable_target_leaf row labelled <crop>_other_unknown is an OOD example and receives no condition cross-entropy.
Generated, augmented, or derivative images may not appear in validation, calibration, test, or external_test.

A configured duplicate numeric stem is one conservative lineage group regardless of extension or visual distance; adjacent numeric stems join only within the isolated source/class/exact-suffix sequence and only when their pHash distance satisfies the bounded source rule.
